title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 33
description: Ten questions on Genesis 33: Jacob meets Esau again, then settles at Succoth and Shechem.

questions.text: Who did Jacob place at the rear when Esau approached?
questions.explanation: He put the servants and their children in front, Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph at the rear.

questions.text: How many times did Jacob bow to the ground as he came near Esau?
questions.explanation: He passed over in front of them and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

questions.text: What did Esau do when he saw Jacob?
questions.explanation: Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they wept.

answers.text: He sent his men to take the flocks
He ran to meet him, embraced him and kissed him
He refused to look at him

questions.text: How did Jacob answer when Esau asked, "Who are these with you?"
questions.explanation: Jacob said, "The children whom God has graciously given your servant."

answers.text: "These are my servants and their families, my lord."
"The daughters of Laban and the servants he gave them."
"People I hired in Paddan Aram to keep my flocks."
"The children whom God has graciously given your servant."

questions.text: What did Esau first say about Jacob's present?
questions.explanation: Esau said, "I have enough, my brother; let that which you have be yours."

answers.text: "I will take only the camels and their colts."
"I have enough, my brother; let that which you have be yours."
"Your present is too small for a brother like me."
"Send all of it on ahead of me to Seir."

questions.text: Why did Jacob not want to travel at Esau's pace?
questions.explanation: Jacob said the children were tender and the flocks and herds had young, so he would lead on gently at the pace of the livestock and the children.

answers.text: The children were tender and the flocks had young
He was afraid of Esau's four hundred men
He wanted to go back to Laban
He had to wait for Rachel to give birth

questions.text: Where did Esau return that day?
questions.explanation: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.

questions.text: Why was the place called Succoth?
questions.explanation: Jacob traveled to Succoth, built himself a house, and made shelters for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

answers.text: Jacob wrestled with a man there until daybreak
Esau and Jacob wept there together
Jacob made shelters there for his livestock
Jacob dug a well there for his flocks

questions.text: How much did Jacob pay the children of Hamor for the parcel of ground?
questions.explanation: He bought the parcel of ground where he had spread his tent from the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for one hundred pieces of money.

questions.text: What did Jacob call the altar he built near Shechem?
questions.explanation: Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, erected an altar there, and called it El Elohe Israel.
